decisions.reason: As a close-to-core compliance tool with an explicitly positive agency-oriented signal and no clear evidence of performance below aspiration, management would likely keep it while learning under favorable industry conditions.

Because it is presented as the flagship platform and sits at the center of the firm’s stated direction, behavioral management would tolerate early uncertainty and continue backing it unless results were clearly poor.

This managed hosting plan is close to the established business and benefits from organizational slack in a growing market, but with weaker visible proof of traction than A or B it faces a somewhat higher—though still minority—risk of being withdrawn or folded into the core offer.
